title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

London (Hybrid, 3 days per week in office) | Up to £60,000


This is an excellent opportunity for a Data Analyst to join a highly data-driven organisation where analytics plays a key role in shaping business and customer decisions. You'll work across a variety of projects, turning complex data into actionable insights while developing your technical and commercial expertise in a collaborative environment.


The Company

They are a well-established organisation that uses data, technology and analytics to drive measurable business outcomes. With a strong focus on innovation and continuous improvement, they empower teams to make informed decisions through high-quality data and insight. The business offers a supportive environment where curiosity, learning and collaboration are actively encouraged.


The Role

You will play a key role in delivering insight and analytics that support business performance and customer strategy.

Responsibilities include:

  • Analysing customer and business data to identify trends, opportunities and actionable insights
  • Delivering post-campaign and performance analysis to support decision-making
  • Developing customer profiles and audience insights
  • Supporting testing and measurement initiatives to evaluate business and marketing performance
  • Creating reports, dashboards and visualisations for stakeholders
  • Building measurement frameworks and KPI structures
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to provide data-driven recommendations
  • Presenting findings and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong SQL and/or Python skills for data extraction and analysis
  • Experience working with customer, product, marketing, sales or business datasets
  • Ability to query data from cloud-based environments such as AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience translating data into clear business recommendations
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Naturally curious with a strong attention to detail

Desirable experience:

  • Data visualisation and dashboarding tools
  • Web or digital analytics
  • Statistical analysis
  • Customer segmentation or modelling
  • Marketing technology platforms and campaign analytics
  • Test and learn methodologies


How to Apply

To find out more about this Data Analyst opportunity, please apply with your CV for a confidential discussion.
